deployments_detail.use: Microsoft 365 Copilot for Sales integrated into Outlook and Teams to keep CRM data current, summarize email threads, draft customer responses and surface account views for commercial insurance sales teams. Deployed with ~300 active Copilot users. [Microsoft (365 Copilot for Sales / Dynamics 365)]
deployments_detail.value: ~14,000 hours projected saved over the next year; ~300 active users; improved sales and retention ratios

deployments_detail.use: Zurich Hong Kong uses Microsoft Dynamics 365 Contact Center (deployed) to unify WhatsApp, call, SMS and email channels, plus Copilot Studio AI agents for initial customer-service triage and motor-claim preliminary capture; Copilot in Customer Service being piloted to help staff search the knowledge base during live chats. [Microsoft (Dynamics 365 Contact Center / Copilot Studio)]
deployments_detail.value: Live chat now 10-20% of incoming call volume; agents handle up to two chats simultaneously

deployments_detail.use: ZARA claims chatbot (built with Spixii) provides 24/7 first-notification-of-loss for motor and property claims, guiding customers through reporting; expanded from personal lines to SME/commercial insurance customers. [Spixii]
deployments_detail.value: Reports a claim in under 3 minutes on average; over 3,000 claims reported since 2018 launch

GenAI for claims summarization, medical doc summaries, key-term & PII/PHI redaction (Zurich "AI at Zurich" disclosure)
GenAI tools supporting faster underwriting decisions

Sixfold generative-AI underwriting assistant creates full underwriting narratives in minutes, distilling thousands of pages of exposure data, loss runs and risk reports for US Middle Market underwriters. Launched in 4 USMM offices in Jan 2025 and expanding to dozens more countrywide. [Sixfold]
deployments_detail.value: ~60 minutes saved per submission; 80% of submissions by 16 underwriters used Sixfold in initial rollout

deployments_detail.use: Microsoft Azure OpenAI Service powers language-AI, multimodal (image/email/report) processing, multilingual support and text-to-speech to accelerate underwriting and risk assessment across global operations. Part of a portfolio of 200+ AI tools deployed. [Microsoft (Azure OpenAI Service)]

Amazon SageMaker AI used to build a proactive flood-claim prediction model that continuously monitors UK customer properties for flood risk and provides early warning, matching addresses to property reference numbers with weather/geographic data. Standardized MLOps on SageMaker with AI Assurance Framework integration. [AWS (Amazon SageMaker AI)]
deployments_detail.value: Deployment speed cut from ~26 weeks to ~8 weeks with reusable patterns

deployments_detail.use: Zurich Program IQ, an in-house AI tool, analyzes policy documents to detect inconsistencies between local and master policies across regions, languages and currencies (initially property nat-cat sublimits) to strengthen contract certainty in multinational insurance programs. In use by underwriting experts. [Zurich (in-house)]

Convr AI underwriting workbench (Intake AI) uses machine learning and computer vision to extract submission data from ACORD forms, loss runs and other documents, then cleanse and enrich it, applied to automobile underwriting for Zurich North America. In production across North America. [Convr]

CLARA multi-agent AI system (with AgentricAI) reads PDFs, photos and handwriting, verifies coverage, decides approval/denial and drafts customer communications under human supervision, piloted for travel claims via Zurich Cover-More with planned production rollout in Australia and the US. [AgentricAI]
deployments_detail.value: 47 seconds average processing time (down from hours)

deployments_detail.use: LISA partnership automates healthcare claims processing in Chile, automating roughly two-thirds of health claims with payout in under ten minutes; part of Zurich's proactive/automated claims initiatives. [LISA (Zurich Chile partnership)]
deployments_detail.value: ~2/3 of health claims automated; payout under 10 minutes; ~1/3 cost reduction (~USD 1 million/year)

deployments_detail.use: Quantexa AI-enabled platform for real-time claims fraud detection; claims handlers input claim details normally and the system alerts them to suspicious activity using expanded data sources. Operating in production for three years (UK). [Quantexa]
deployments_detail.value: Detected the equivalent of GBP 260,000 of bogus claims per day in 2024
